title: REWARD MODELS INHERIT VALUE BIASES FROM PRETRAINING
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the models' preference for words related to the moral foundation of 'sanctity/purity', a concept often associated with religious and moral frameworks, as part of a broader analysis of value biases along several psychological dimensions.
findings: Gemma-based reward models showed a stronger preference for words related to the moral dimension of 'sanctity/purity' compared to Llama-based models, particularly when responding to positively framed prompts.
references: Andrea E Abele and Bogdan Wojciszke. Agency and Communion in Social Psychology, volume 10. Routledge London, UK, 2018.
